subject: Provisional billing schedule request — SummitTech
messages:
From: Oliver Hayes <oliver.hayes@summittech.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: accounts-payable@summittech.com
Date: Tue, 15 Dec 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Request: provisional billing cadence and milestone invoicing for SummitTech

Sean —

Thanks for the demo last week. SummitTech is ready to move forward but procurement has flagged our standard monthly invoice cadence as a blocker for their internal forecasting. They are asking for a provisional quarterly billing schedule for the first year of the contract (one invoice per quarter) and to align invoices to three usage milestones we outlined in the attached SOW.

Key asks from our side:
- Quarterly invoicing (Jan/Apr/Jul/Oct) for the first 12 months
- Net-60 payment terms on each quarterly invoice
- A one-time initial invoice that covers a 20% prepay to trigger provisioning

We attached the updated SOW (SummitTech_SOW_v2.pdf) for reference. Procurement also asked if Redwood can temporarily waive the standard prepay percentage beyond the 20% for the first quarter while they complete their budget sign-off. They need this spelled out in an amendment so AP can process.

Appreciate your help — procurement is hoping to have terms confirmed by next Monday.

Best,
Oliver Hayes
VP, Strategic Programs
SummitTech

Attachments: SummitTech_SOW_v2.pdf
From: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwoodinference.com>
To: Oliver Hayes <oliver.hayes@summittech.com>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com, marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com
Date: Wed, 16 Dec 2026 11:04:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: provisional billing cadence and milestone invoicing for SummitTech

Oliver —

Thanks for the clear summary and the SOW. We can support a provisional quarterly invoicing cadence for the first year, but I need to run a small set of guardrails by Finance for net-60 and the reduced prepay ask. Proposed approach we can take now to unblock procurement quickly:

1) Provisional billing schedule (proposed):
   - Initial invoice: 20% prepay (due on provisioning) — required to start service
   - Remaining commitment: billed quarterly (one invoice per quarter) with invoices issued on the first business day of Jan/Apr/Jul/Oct
   - Payment terms: Net-60 for quarterly invoices (Finance escalation required)

2) Conditions from Redwood:
   - Signed amendment to SOW (we will generate a short amendment)
   - Finance reserves the right to require a payment instrument (card on file or wire authorization) if a payment is late
   - We will set a 90-day review clause: if AP falls behind more than one invoice, terms revert to standard monthly billing or prepayment as appropriate

Ive looped in Laura (Finance) and Marissa (AE lead) to get a fast review and request exec signoff if Finance flags material risk. Laura — can you please review the risk/approval ask and confirm whether we need an exec approval for Net-60 on this account? Marissa — heads up we'll want to communicate the amendment language and next steps to SummitTech after approval.

I can draft the amendment and a one-page finance memo for signoff. Oliver — if that approach looks ok well move to a DocuSign amendment and aim to have it to you by Friday.

Thanks,
Sean Gallagher
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
sean_gallagher@redwoodinference.com | +1 415-555-0112

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwoodinference.com>, marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com
Date: Thu, 17 Dec 2026 09:31:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: provisional billing cadence and milestone invoicing for SummitTech

Team —

Reviewed the proposal and ran the numbers against the ARR profile. Summary: SummitTech estimate ~ $480k first-year commit under the attached SOW. Finance is comfortable *considering* quarterly invoicing with Net-60 for a limited pilot, but this requires explicit executive approval because it increases DSO and pushes cash collection risk into the next quarter.

Risks and mitigations:
- Risk: material DSO increase (~30 days uplift). Mitigation: require the 20% prepay + require a payment instrument on file (card or ACH authorization) to be used only if invoice becomes delinquent.
- Risk: delayed revenue recognition complexity. Mitigation: include a 90-day rollback clause and require monthly status reporting from the AE to Finance for the first two quarters.
- Risk: precedent with other mid-market accounts. Mitigation: mark as a one-year pilot (explicitly limited in amendment).

Requested executive approvals (we need a single reply-all signoff):
1) Approve provisional quarterly invoicing with Net-60 for up to 4 quarters for DL-84217
2) Approve exception to standard prepay policy to accept a 20% prepay for provisioning (temporary)
3) Approve the conditional mitigations above (card-on-file, 90-day rollback, monthly reporting)

I attached a suggested payment plan and the finance memo in the spreadsheet (SummitTech_payment_plan.xlsx). If we can get an approval by end of week, Sean — well prepare the DocuSign amendment and a short finance memo to attach to the contract.

Thanks,
Laura Bennett
Head of Finance | Redwood Inference
laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com

Attachments: SummitTech_payment_plan.xlsx
From: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwoodinference.com>, laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com, marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com
Date: Fri, 19 Dec 2026 16:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: provisional billing cadence and milestone invoicing for SummitTech

All —

I reviewed the ask and the mitigations. Approved with conditions. For DL-84217 (SummitTech):

- Approval: provisional quarterly invoicing with Net-60 for up to 4 quarters is approved.
- Conditions (must be in amendment before signature):
  1) 20% prepay collected at provisioning (non-negotiable)
  2) DocuSign amendment must include a 90-day rollback clause and a requirement to place a payment instrument on file (card/ACH) for collection only if invoices become >15 days overdue
  3) AE must deliver monthly status updates to Finance for the first two quarters (first update due 30 days after first quarterly invoice)
  4) Any early payment discounts or permanent policy changes require separate exec approval — do not grant broad discounts here

Sean — you have signoff to proceed to DocuSign with the amendment language Laura proposed and to confirm acceptance with the customer. Marissa — work with Contract Ops to ensure the amendment is limited to a one-year pilot and tagged in HubSpot (deal DL-84217). Laura — if payments become delinquent, please notify me and Legal so we can escalate.

Jonas Weber
VP, Revenue Operations | Redwood Inference
jonas_weber@redwoodinference.com
